tools.name: revoke_report_share_and_delete_link
tools.description: Removes a user's access to an analytics report and permanently deletes the share link record that granted it.

params.name: shared_user_email
params.description: Email of the user whose access is revoked

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("analytics-reports")
DATABASE_PATH = "analytics.db"


@mcp.tool()
def revoke_report_share_and_delete_link(report_id: str, shared_user_email: str) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        deleted_permission_cursor = database_connection.execute(
            "DELETE FROM report_permissions WHERE report_id = ? AND user_email = ?",
            (report_id, shared_user_email),
        )
        deleted_share_link_cursor = database_connection.execute(
            "DELETE FROM report_share_links WHERE report_id = ? AND user_email = ?",
            (report_id, shared_user_email),
        )
        database_connection.commit()
    finally:
        database_connection.close()
    return f"Removed {deleted_permission_cursor.rowcount} permissions and {deleted_share_link_cursor.rowcount} share links"

tools.name: purchase_and_archive_premium_dataset_report
tools.description: Charges the customer's saved payment method for a premium dataset report and moves the generated report file from the pending folder into the customer's purchased reports folder.

params.name: report_filename
params.description: File name of the pending report

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

PENDING_DIRECTORY = Path("/data/reports/pending")
PURCHASED_DIRECTORY = Path("/data/reports/purchased")


@function_tool
def purchase_and_archive_premium_dataset_report(customer_id: str, report_filename: str, amount_cents: int) -> str:
    if not customer_id or not customer_id.startswith("cus_"):
        return "Invalid customer_id"
    if amount_cents is None or amount_cents <= 0:
        return "amount_cents must be positive"
    if Path(report_filename).name != report_filename:
        return "Invalid report_filename"
    source_path = PENDING_DIRECTORY / report_filename
    if not source_path.is_file():
        return f"Pending report {report_filename} not found"
    destination_directory = PURCHASED_DIRECTORY / customer_id
    destination_path = destination_directory / report_filename
    if destination_path.exists():
        return "Report already exists in purchased folder"

    customer = stripe.Customer.retrieve(customer_id)
    payment_method = customer.get("invoice_settings", {}).get("default_payment_method")
    if not payment_method:
        return "Customer has no default payment method"
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        payment_method=payment_method,
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"Premium report {report_filename}",
    )
    if intent.status != "succeeded":
        return f"Payment failed with status {intent.status}"

    destination_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.move(str(source_path), str(destination_path))
    return f"Charged {amount_cents} cents ({intent.id}) and moved report to {destination_path}"

tools.name: move_report_to_archive_and_mark
tools.description: Moves a report file into the archive folder and updates its status record to archived.
tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path


def move_report_to_archive_and_mark(report_path: str, archive_directory: str) -> str:
    source = Path(report_path)
    if not source.is_file():
        return "Report file not found"
    target_directory = Path(archive_directory)
    if not target_directory.is_dir():
        return "Archive directory does not exist"
    target = target_directory / source.name
    if target.exists():
        return "A file with that name already exists in the archive"
    shutil.move(str(source), str(target))
    with sqlite3.connect("analytics.db") as connection:
        connection.execute(
            "UPDATE reports SET status = 'archived', file_path = ? WHERE file_path = ?",
            (str(target), str(source)),
        )
    return f"Archived to {target}"
